fixed_budget_policy: Freeze the validation-stopped selected checkpoint once patience is reached; continue only for the predeclared fixed-budget trajectory and endpoint. No later checkpoint replaces that selection.
ordinal_heads: Same initial head as joint scratch; concurrent level-plus-change updates on detached scores, without feedback into ordinal scorer.
warm_initialization: Original paired diagnostic A_0 scorer and calibrated level head; fresh Adam state. No Q checkpoint or oracle-selected state.
